gen-dafont-joystix-gf-puritan: Joystix stamps out wide-tracked, arcade-bold letters with stems barely heavier than their arms. And Puritan keeps things friendly, its rounded forms and oversized counters staying open to the side.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-questrial: Loud arcade attitude, with Joystix spreading its letters wide and holding stems just above arm weight. But Questrial reads smoothly over a full page, its single-weight strokes flat and its open curves easy to follow.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-radio-canada: Bold Joystix sets arcade letters wide, its heavy stems and lighter arms sitting close together. Radio Canada holds one steady line with no pressure variation, and its curves end in clear openings.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-readex-pro: Readex Pro reads in a quiet, unvarying line with broad terminal gaps. Joystix does the loud work, wide-tracked and sturdy even in its thinnest strokes, while the body just keeps its straight-edged strokes constant.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-ruda: Approachable Ruda looks like thin tubing bent into loops. Joystix is the one to make noise, wide-tracked with stems a touch heavier than hairlines, while Ruda quietly does the reading.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-sarpanch: Approachable Sarpanch keeps its lowercase e clearly open, a friendly foil for the wide-tracked arcade punch of Joystix. Sarpanch then reads smoothly down the paragraph, its compact ascender gap keeping lines tidy.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Joystix brings arcade swagger in wide-tracked, sturdy letters. Schibsted Grotesk then settles into paragraphs with big open e and a bowls and terminals that never close in, so text keeps flowing.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-sen: Joystix goes loud: wide-tracked, arcade-bold, stems barely heavier than arms. Sen builds its lowercase tall and keeps every stroke constant, so paragraphs glide along, curves ending before they turn inward.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-sintony: Sintony has a chunky, tall midzone and a smooth read. Joystix, wide-tracked and arcade-bold, hollers above it while text in Sintony flows on, paragraph after paragraph, without clogged curves.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-sofia-sans-semi-co: Tall, nearly capital-height lowercase makes Sofia Sans Semi Condensed read crisp and steady. Sofia Sans Semi Condensed keeps its bent-wire strokes constant while Joystix supplies the wide-tracked arcade noise above.
